# claimreserve ![](man/figures/logo.png){align="right" height="120"}

<!-- badges: start -->

[![R-CMD-check](https://img.shields.io/badge/R--CMD--check-passing-brightgreen.svg)]() [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

<!-- badges: end -->

`claimreserve` provides lightweight, fast utilities to transform raw transactional claims records into loss run-off triangles and estimate **Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR)** claims reserves using the standard Chain-Ladder development technique.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Features

- **Automated Triangle Aggregation**: Convert transactional origin/development records directly into cumulative run-off matrices.
- **Volume-Weighted Link Ratios**: Vectorized calculation of loss development factors ($f_j$).
- **IBNR Estimation**: Automatic projection of unobserved claims and net required reserves.
- **Diagnostic Plotting**: Built-in visual check for claims maturity curves across accident years.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Installation

You can install the development version of `claimreserve` from GitHub:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("your-username/claimreserve")
```

Or install locally from source:

``` r
devtools::install()
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Quick Start

``` r
library(claimreserve)

# 1. Sample transactional insurance claims
claims_data <- data.frame(
  accident_year = c(2021, 2021, 2021, 2022, 2022, 2023),
  dev_year      = c(1,    2,    3,    1,    2,    1),
  paid_amount   = c(100,  50,   25,   120,  60,   110)
)

# 2. Build cumulative triangle
tri <- make_triangle(
  data   = claims_data,
  origin = "accident_year",
  dev    = "dev_year",
  amount = "paid_amount"
)
print(tri)

# 3. Fit Chain-Ladder model and estimate IBNR
res <- fit_chain_ladder(tri)

# View volume-weighted factors
res$factors

# View required reserves by origin year
res$ibnr_reserve

# 4. Plot development trajectory
plot_development(tri)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Mathematical Formulation

The link ratios ($f_j$) are estimated via volume-weighted averages:

$$f_j = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n-j} C_{i, j+1}}{\sum_{i=1}^{n-j} C_{i,j}}$$

Where $C_{i,j}$ represents the cumulative claims for accident year $i$ at development period $j$.
